name: Kaelen Ashwing
role: Windlord of Windspire: rules the elven sky city chained to the eastern peaks, and flies the anchor-lines himself
appearance: Wiry, wind-burned, hair cropped short for the glider, and a scar across both palms from the anchor-chains.
voiceHints: Breezy, quick, restless on the ground. Treats danger as weather.
wants: To fly the longest anchor-line in the world and come back.
fears: A chain snapping in the night.
knowledge: Which Somatic climbers have tried the chains and how far they got
